data.name: Harshan
data.gender_notes: Harshan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harshan means 'happy' or 'radiant'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'harsh', which means 'shining'. It is a name that embodies joy and positivity. The name Harshan carries the meaning “Happy, Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshan usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of Lord Vishnu, meaning 'shining' or 'radiant'

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harshan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Harshavardhana, also known as Harshan, ruled the Hindu kingdom of Thanesar (modern Haryana, India) from 606 to 647 AD.

Harshan, another famous Hindu figure, is believed to have been a Jain monk who lived in the 12th century AD. He was a renowned philosopher, scholar, and poet, and is best known for his work 'Naisadhacariyamrutha' in Kannada language.
